commands:
set -euo pipefail
echo RUN
date -u
echo ENV_KEYS
for k in RAGIN_MTLS_CERT_FILE RAGIN_MTLS_KEY_FILE RAGIN_MTLS_CA_FILE; do
  v="${!k:-}"
  if [ -n "$v" ]; then echo "${k}_SET=yes path=${v} exists=$( [ -f "$v" ] && echo yes || echo no )"; fi
done
CERTS_READY=0
if [ -n "${RAGIN_MTLS_CERT_FILE:-}" ] && [ -n "${RAGIN_MTLS_KEY_FILE:-}" ] && [ -n "${RAGIN_MTLS_CA_FILE:-}" ] && \
   [ -f "${RAGIN_MTLS_CERT_FILE:-}" ] && [ -f "${RAGIN_MTLS_KEY_FILE:-}" ] && [ -f "${RAGIN_MTLS_CA_FILE:-}" ]; then
  CERTS_READY=1
fi
TMPDIR=$(mktemp -d)
echo TMPDIR=$TMPDIR
echo CASE_DEFINITIONS
cat > "$TMPDIR/cases.txt" <<'CASELIST'
1_missing_cert: openssl s_client without -cert/-key
2_bad_ca_chain: openssl s_client with -CAfile pointing to nonexistent file
CASELIST
echo OPENSSL_S_CLIENT_CASES
if [ "$CERTS_READY" = "1" ] && command -v openssl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "CASE_1_MISSING_CERT"
  if openssl s_client -connect 172.31.17.217:8443 \
    -CAfile "${RAGIN_MTLS_CA_FILE}" \
    -verify_return_error \
    -brief -no_ign_eof < /dev/null > "$TMPDIR/case1_missing_cert.txt" 2>&1; then
    echo CASE1_EXIT=0
  else
    echo CASE1_EXIT=$?
  fi
  echo "--- case1 head ---"
  head -n 80 "$TMPDIR/case1_missing_cert.txt"
  echo "CASE_2_BAD_CA_CHAIN"
  if openssl s_client -connect 172.31.17.217:8443 \
    -CAfile "$TMPDIR/nonexistent_ca.crt" \
    -verify_return_error \
    -brief -no_ign_eof < /dev/null > "$TMPDIR/case2_bad_ca.txt" 2>&1; then
    echo CASE2_EXIT=0
  else
    echo CASE2_EXIT=$?
  fi
  echo "--- case2 head ---"
  head -n 80 "$TMPDIR/case2_bad_ca.txt"
else
  echo CASES_SKIPPED=no_certs_or_no_openssl
fi
rm -rf "$TMPDIR"
echo DONE
